conversations.name: Stewardess
conversations.content: Oh no, miss. I'm afraid you’re not allowed to bother the passengers up front.

conversations.name: Me
conversations.content: (She hangs a smiling face, but somehow her words make me quite uncomfortable.)

conversations.name: Stewardess
conversations.content: Is there anything else, miss? If not, please move along—you’re blocking the aisle.

conversations.name: Stewardess
conversations.content: The restroom for economy is waaay down at the other end, dear.

conversations.name: Me
conversations.content: (Was she just glaring at me? She's so done with me already. I should just leave.)
